def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):

    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def background(grid):
    """The most common color in the grid."""
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def bounding_box(grid, bg):
    """(r0, r1, c0, c1) of all cells whose color differs from bg."""
    cells = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    return (min(i for i, j in cells), max(i for i, j in cells),
            min(j for i, j in cells), max(j for i, j in cells))

def extract(grid, box):
    """The subgrid of grid covered by a (r0, r1, c0, c1) box."""
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = box
    return [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]

def paste(grid, sub, top, left):
    """A copy of grid with sub written at (top, left)."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i, row in enumerate(sub):
        out[top + i][left:left + len(row)] = row
    return out

def fill_row(grid, i, color):
    """A copy of grid with row i set entirely to color."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    out[i] = [color] * len(grid[0])
    return out
